heritage.title: Our Legacy
heritage.description: Established in 2064 B.S., Purandhara Everest Academy has been a beacon of knowledge and excellence for decades.
heritage.introText: Purandhara Everest Academy was established with a vision to provide world-class education to the children of Babai and surrounding areas. Over the years, we have grown into a cornerstone of the community, known for our high academic standards and holistic development approach.

mission: To create a safe, joyful, and inspiring environment where children can learn, explore, and grow with confidence. We empower students to become responsible, innovative, and compassionate leaders of tomorrow.
vision: To be a pioneering educational institution recognized for excellence in holistic development, fostering a lifelong love for learning, and shaping global citizens with strong local values.
